mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_audit_log WHERE action_name='withdrawal.review' AND target_id=#{id})

SELECT i.id AS identityId,i.app_id AS appId,i.open_id AS openId FROM merchant_identity i JOIN merchant m ON m.id=i.merchant_id WHERE i.id=#{identityId} AND i.merchant_id=#{accountId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.audit_status='APPROVED' AND i.open_id<>'' FOR UPDATE OF i

SELECT i.id AS identityId,c.app_id AS appId,c.recipient_open_id AS openId FROM withdrawal_request w JOIN merchant_transfer_channel c ON c.withdrawal_id=w.id JOIN merchant_identity i ON i.merchant_id=w.account_id AND i.app_id=c.app_id AND i.open_id=c.recipient_open_id JOIN merchant m ON m.id=i.merchant_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.audit_status='APPROVED' JOIN wechat_config cfg ON cfg.id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM wechat_config) AND cfg.merchant_app_id=c.app_id AND cfg.merchant_no=c.merchant_no WHERE w.id=#{id} AND w.account_id=#{accountId} AND c.channel_state IN ('FAIL','CANCELLED') AND (w.applicant_identity_id IS NULL OR (w.applicant_identity_id=i.id AND w.recipient_app_id=c.app_id AND w.recipient_open_id=c.recipient_open_id)) FOR UPDATE OF i

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel c JOIN rider_identity i ON i.rider_id=#{accountId} AND i.app_id=c.app_id AND i.openid=COALESCE(c.recipient_open_id,i.openid) AND i.openid<>'' JOIN wechat_config cfg ON cfg.id=(SELECT MAX(id) FROM wechat_config) AND cfg.rider_app_id=c.app_id AND cfg.merchant_no=c.merchant_no WHERE c.withdrawal_id=#{id} AND c.channel_state IN ('FAIL','CANCELLED'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_transfer_channel WHERE withdrawal_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM withdrawal_request w JOIN merchant_transfer_channel c ON c.withdrawal_id=w.id WHERE w.id=#{id} AND c.recipient_open_id<>'' AND (w.recipient_open_id IS NULL OR (w.recipient_app_id=c.app_id AND w.recipient_open_id=c.recipient_open_id)))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel WHERE withdrawal_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rider_transfer_channel c JOIN withdrawal_transfer t ON t.withdrawal_id=c.withdrawal_id WHERE c.withdrawal_id=#{id} AND c.app_id=#{appId} AND c.merchant_no=#{merchantNo} AND c.channel_state='UNKNOWN' AND c.package_info IS NULL AND t.status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN') AND t.channel_reference IS NULL AND NOT t.retry_requested AND t.created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL 30 DAY )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(frozen_delta),0) FROM account_journal WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND reference_id=#{id}
